adjudication.rationale: publishBulletin retains only a text:string argument and a void result. No publication channel parameter or resource-bearing return requirement names the promised write resource. Compiler probes verify arbitrary text acceptance and rejection of an explicit capability argument. Abstract signatures establish a contract observation, not actual publication IO.
adjudication.rubric: Publishing callable declares a usable publication channel parameter or a resource-bearing effect requirement. Retain arbitrary text publication; removing/renaming away the callable is not repair.
adjudication.limitations: Finite TypeScript 5.9.3 compiler observations validate the listed contract examples. Abstract callable signatures do not establish implementation behavior or actual resource IO.
